card.name: The word milligrams after 4000
card.fires_on: The ending piece "igrams" of the word milligrams, right after "mill" following a dose number such as 4000 or 4,000. It appears in acetaminophen daily-limit warnings.

modes.description: The final piece of milligrams after 4000 in acetaminophen liver-injury warnings.
